name: ohi
description: Find, download and pin ontologies from ohi.dev, and author, validate, import and generate LinkML schemas, all with the ohi CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Find ontologies on ohi.dev and work with LinkML schemas.
interface.longDescription: Find, download and pin ontologies from ohi.dev, and author, validate, review and release LinkML schemas. Covers ohi.yaml project records, importing OWL, RDFS and Apache Ossie ontologies into LinkML, bootstrapping from SHACL, JSON Schema, XSD or sample data, instance-data validation and GitHub Actions setup.
defaultPrompt: Find a provenance ontology on ohi.dev and download it
Add an ontology to my project's ohi.yaml
Create and validate a LinkML schema
